profile.name: Equine Connection: Equine Assisted Learning Course
profile.description:
Belong to a company that invests back into you. It's Not Just A Course... It's a Career! Equine Connection is dedicated first & foremost to the welfare of the horse! We are devoted to excellence in training educational & experiential skills programs that are facilitated within a group or individual format by including the horse. 

Equine-assisted facilitators focus on-ground activities that are objectively results-driven to multiply the participant's success rate to self-discovery for your clients every time you run the exercises provided with your training. You have a calling - a purpose here on Earth. It's not just about making money--it goes beyond that! 

Becoming an Equine Connection Certified Facilitator is about empowering other human beings to acquire powerful skills & step forward in their lives with those skills they develop through the horse. The horse does the teaching, & you do the facilitation. Live your purpose with the life you are meant to live with horses TODAY!
